scope: Independent offline adoption review of the retained completed GPU Debug run and the newly completed GPU Release versus retained same-dt CPU Release. No solver was run by this review; only this new JSON was written.

provenance_review.scope: Retained and continuation check/run/prepared/adoption/completion records, their explicitly bound input/output files and CPU control records; the bound current GPU Debug and Release build records were also opened and their explicit file hashes checked.

debug_adoption.reason_for_old_false_rejection: The old runner additionally required the string All heap blocks were freed. The actual compute-sanitizer output reports LEAK SUMMARY: 0 bytes leaked in 0 allocations and ERROR SUMMARY: 0 errors. The continuation required present zero summaries rather than changing the sealed old result.

review_method_and_ownership.native_reader_calls_scope: Five retained Debug, five new GPU Release and five retained CPU Release unique frames, plus the reused CPU initial reference; no long history or new solve.
review_method_and_ownership.safety_method: Reread native data using the retained original inspect() finite/positive-density/no-exclusion/elastic/precision/actual-load/drainage/mechanical-step/pore-step guard. The existing guard was reused, not advertised as a separately implemented physical safety model.
review_method_and_ownership.process_check: After review, no Cryer GPU solver nor process with recorded sequence/wrapper PIDs 65448, 64648 or 78435 was present. The concurrent CPU fine test was neither stopped nor modified.

limitations: This is a same-dt backend comparison over five saved samples and 200 steps, not independent half-step convergence or analytical Cryer acceptance.
The retained CPU grad0 half-step screen remains failed; a small CPU/GPU difference does not cure it.
Debug and Release were each safety-checked; no Debug/Release 0-ULP equivalence is claimed.
Actual hardware was RTX 3050, not the historical A6000. The observed runtime is not an isolated benchmark because a CPU diagnostic was concurrent.
No old script, receipt, input, native output, production source, notifier or worker was modified or restarted.
